title: Statistical Estimation of Adversarial Risk in Large Language Models under Best-of-N Sampling
reasoning: The paper focuses on a statistical methodology called SABER for estimating jailbreak success rates in LLMs. While it uses the HarmBench dataset and addresses safety/adversarial risk, it does not analyze or evaluate religious, moral, or ethical reasoning, beliefs, or frameworks themselves, but rather the statistical probability of model failure under scale.
